full_prompt_en: A square architectural image shows a modern house with a sweeping curved roof and golden walkway suspended above a wooded valley. The underside of a broad pale concrete canopy fills the upper left and arcs outward into a thin white lip at the center-right. Below it, dark glass walls and black vertical mullions retreat along the left side, reflecting blue sky and vegetation. A second slim horizontal slab projects from the house beneath the canopy, separating the glass facade from the deep blue valley. The walkway begins wide in the lower left and curves toward the center, its mustard-yellow surface marked by patches of pale reflection or weathering. A smooth low parapet follows the walkway's outer edge, bending in an S-curve above dense shrubs. Planting beds and a low stone border line its inner edge near the building. Tall slender trees rise on the right, their trunks crossing the distant blue-green hills and airy sky. Smaller crowns and leafy branches fill the middle distance and soften the house's hard glass panels. Bright daylight from the upper right lights the pale canopy edge and yellow paving, while the canopy underside stays a cool gray. Deeper blue shadows collect in the glazed recesses, and distant forest layers fade into mist. The surfaces are clean but not sterile: panel seams are visible overhead, and foliage has many fine irregular leaves. No people or readable signs appear. The overall composition is open and fluid, setting a warm curving route beneath a cool floating plane and surrounding it with layered trees and sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑图像呈现一栋现代住宅，拥有横扫的曲线屋顶和悬在林木山谷上方的金色步道。宽大浅色混凝土雨棚底面填满左上，并向外弧伸为中右部一条细白边。其下，深色玻璃墙和黑竖窗框沿左侧后退，反射蓝天和植被。第二块细水平楼板在雨棚下从房屋伸出，把玻璃立面与深蓝山谷分开。步道从左下方宽阔起步，向中央弯去，芥末黄色表面留有浅色反光或风化斑。一道平顺低矮护墙沿步道外缘延伸，在密集灌木上方弯成S形。建筑一侧的花床和低石边沿步道内缘排列。高而细的树木从右侧升起，树干横过远方蓝绿山丘与通透天空。较小树冠和叶枝填满中景，柔化房屋坚硬的玻璃面板。明亮日光从右上照来，照亮浅色雨棚边缘和黄铺面，雨棚底面保持冷灰。更深蓝影聚在玻璃凹处，远处森林层次褪入薄雾。表面干净却不无菌：头顶可见板缝，草木有许多细小不规则叶片。画中没有人物或可读招牌。整体构图开阔而流动，把暖色弯曲路线放在冷调漂浮平面下，并由层叠树木与天空环绕。
style_prompt_en: The image combines broad pale floating planes, long sweeping curves, dark reflective strips, and densely textured organic surroundings. Cool sky blue and forest green dominate the distant field, while a single warm golden route provides a strong eye-leading accent. Crisp constructed edges contrast with irregular leaves and softly fading depth. Overhead shade makes undersides cool gray; bright side daylight catches thin lips and exposed horizontal surfaces. A low viewpoint intensifies the curve and lets overlapping layers recede toward a hazy opening. Panel seams and delicate reflections add material specificity without clutter. The overall effect is airy, fluid, and refined, with movement generated by curves against calm horizontal planes.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅图像把宽阔浅色漂浮平面、长而横扫的曲线、深色反光条带和密集有肌理的有机环境结合。冷天蓝与森林绿主导远处色场，一条暖金路线提供强烈引导视线的重音。清楚的人工边缘对照不规则叶片与逐渐柔化的深度。头顶遮蔽使底面呈冷灰，明亮侧日光碰到薄边和暴露的水平表面。低视点强化曲线，让重叠层次向朦胧开口后退。板缝与细反射增加材料特征，却不造成杂乱。整体效果通透、流动而精致，运动感由曲线对照安静水平面产生。
theme_en: A curving modern house and golden walkway above a wooded valley
theme_zh: 林木山谷上方的曲线现代住宅与金色步道
name: Harry Seidler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
